_doc: Config of tools/hw_checks/hw_checks.py (local run and bitbucket-pipelines.yml). See the script docstring. Add one entry to boards per KiCad project when it exists (hardware/<Board>/<Board>.kicad_pro), then write the baseline: python tools/hw_checks/hw_checks.py --update-baseline

ignore.reason: TrueType board texts: the stroke-width estimate differs between Windows and the Linux CI image; cosmetic silkscreen rule

known_failure.match: ^- .+: in the schematic but no datasheet in the manifest$
known_failure.reason: 26 datasheets are on disk by part number (2026-11-16), but the v1 schematic values are descriptive (e.g. ADS1115 (0x48), CH1 +24/GND/Iin/Iout) and match no manifest row; the values become part numbers at rev 1.1 (reports/CheckOne/review_2026-11-16.md section 3 item 7), then remove this

release._doc: tools/hw_checks/hw_release.py: tag <prefix>-v<version>[-rcN] -> board and documents ({version} = tag version). Add one entry per board under boards, e.g. "wind": {"board": "CheckOne", "documents": [...]}
